media.title: Music
media.music_note: Controls the music app of this device: song, pause, next and your playlists.
media.denied: No access. Please allow “Media & Apple Music” for CoDriveMate in the iPad settings.
media.only_ipad: Apple Music can only be controlled in the app on iPad and iPhone.
media.link: Link to a video or playlist
media.name: Name
media.invalid: This link cannot be played. Personal mixes do not work, normal playlists and videos do.
media.youtube_note: The player replaces the 3D view and keeps running next to the map. Watch only while parked. Playing sends data to Google (USA).
media.player_failed: The player could not be opened.

remote.none: Controls YouTube Music, Spotify and any other app. Tap, choose the module and confirm “Pair” on the iPad.
remote.pairing: Connected. Waiting for the iPad: please confirm “Pair”.
remote.on: Ready. Title and buttons apply to the app that is playing.
remote.failed: Module not reachable. Is it switched on and Bluetooth allowed?

esp.title: Set up ESP32 module
esp.none: No module connected yet. It shows and controls the music of any app on the iPad.

parts.title: What you need
parts.h1: An ESP32 board with Bluetooth LE, for example an ESP32 DevKit, ESP32-S3 or -C3. An ESP32-S2 does not work, it has no Bluetooth.
parts.h2: A USB data cable and a computer with the Arduino IDE.
parts.h3: A USB charger for the car.

flash.title: Install the firmware
flash.h1: Download the firmware and open it in the Arduino IDE.
flash.h2: Install “esp32” by Espressif in the boards manager.
flash.h3: Install “NimBLE-Arduino” 2.5 or newer in the library manager.
flash.h4: Connect the board and select board and port.
flash.h6: If the upload fails: hold the BOOT button until it starts.

power.title: Connect in the car
power.h1: Easiest: plug the board into the car charger by USB.
power.h2: Never connect it to 12 volts directly. A fixed installation needs a converter to 5 volts and a fuse; ask a professional if in doubt.
power.h3: Fix it so that it cannot fall into the footwell.

connect.title: Connect to the iPad
connect.h2: Confirm “Pair” on the iPad. This is only needed the first time.
connect.h3: If the iPad does not ask: remove the module in the iPad settings under Bluetooth (“Forget This Device”) and connect again.

test.title: Try it
test.h1: Start music in any app, for example YouTube Music or Spotify, and come back here.
test.h2: Title and buttons should appear within a few seconds.
